banner: HISTORICAL REPLAY of BATADAL dataset04 (C-Town benchmark simulation, 2016). Not live telemetry and not a real city installation.

documented_attack.description: Like Attack #5, but speed reduced to 0.7.
documented_attack.concealment: L_T4 drop concealed with replay attack.

context_note: Attack 6 lies in the held-out test period evaluated once at Checkpoint 4; this replay only re-displays the frozen model's output for that period.

events.disclaimer: Advisory physical-process anomaly. Not a confirmed cyberattack, device compromise or service outage; requires investigation.
events.reference_note: overlaps documented BATADAL attack 6 (2016-12-06 07h to 2016-12-10 04h); reference for evaluation/demo only, not a detector conclusion

suggested_correlation: Review vulnerabilities and attack paths that reach the listed city assets and telemetry-path assets
Check whether an entry point on those paths shows other evidence (logins, config changes)
Verify field readings independently before acting on the process
